name: Support Kira/Brennan B
_source: speak;Kira;Brennan. If something happens to me tomorrow—
speak;Brennan;Nothing is going to happen to you.
speak;Brennan;Twenty-eight years surviving things that should've killed me. I know enough.
speak;Kira;Thank you. For staying when the king fell.
speak;Brennan;My loyalty is to Valdres. Right now, Valdres follows you.
